projectDescription: A hands-on GenAI and Agentic-AI practice platform with five labs covering RAG, tool calling, LangGraph agents, multi-agent systems, and MCP — deployable as a Streamlit app or a browser-based JupyterLab.
keyFeatures: Five end-to-end GenAI labs: RAG, Tool Calling, LangGraph Agent, Multi-Agent, and MCP
Real code execution via Python exec() — no simulation, genuine stdout/stderr/tracebacks
Criterion-based grading engine using AST analysis and runtime namespace inspection
Multi-mode LLM support: OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini), Claude (claude-sonnet-4-5), and keyless Mock
Real ChromaDB vector store with automatic fallback to LangChain InMemoryVectorStore
FastEmbed ONNX local embeddings for keyless operation
Progressive hints, solution reveal, and per-criterion score breakdown
Excel/CSV/JSON score export from the Score page
YAML-driven content model — add a lab by dropping a practice.yaml file
Dual deployment targets: Streamlit Community Cloud app and browser-based JupyterLab
Real FastMCP stdio server (mcp_server.py) for the MCP lab
Developer mode showing per-criterion pass/fail, earned points, and exact graded source
publicApiSurface: grader.grade_task(task_id, learner_code, *, lab_id, accumulated_source, mode, dev) -> dict
content/<lab_id>/practice.yaml: lab_id, title, requires, mode_required, overview, tasks[]
